# MyTravelExpert — Bespoke Himalayan Journeys

> Regional tour operator and destination management desk headquartered in Bagdogra (Darjeeling District, West Bengal), specializing in customized private expeditions, hotel stays, and hill-certified vehicle rentals across Darjeeling, Sikkim, Bhutan, Kalimpong, the Old Silk Route, and Dooars.
